# Multi-Client File and System Information Server made using code generated by Claude Sonnet 5.5.

A pure-Java TCP client/server application. The server handles many clients concurrently
(fixed thread pool of 20), authenticates users, serves file operations confined to a
shared `server-storage/` directory, and reports system information.

To Build

Requires JDK 11+.

```
# Plain javac (from the project root)
mkdir out
javac -d out $(find src -name "*.java")        # PowerShell: javac -d out (Get-ChildItem src -Recurse -Filter *.java).FullName

# or Maven
mvn package
```

To Run

Server (optional args: port, storage directory; defaults 5000 and `server-storage`):

```
java -cp out com.networks.server.ServerMain [port] [storageDir]
```

Client (run on the same or a different machine; prompts for IP and port if no args):

```
java -cp out com.networks.client.ClientMain [serverIp] [port]
```

For two computers: start the server, note its IP (`ipconfig` / `ip a`), allow the port through
the firewall, and give that IP to the client. Run as many clients as you like in separate terminals.

Accounts

| Username | Password   |
|----------|------------|
| admin    | admin123   |
| alice    | alice123   |
| bob      | bob123     |

Three consecutive failed logins on one connection disconnect the client.

Menu

Files: 1 List, 2 Upload, 3 Download, 4 Delete, 5 Info, 6 Exit.
System: 7 Time, 8 Uptime, 9 Memory, 10 Clients, 11 Threads.

Downloads are saved to `client-downloads/` in the client's working directory. The upload prompt
takes a local file path; the file is stored on the server under its base name.
